build_system: setuptools with pyproject.toml, setup.py is minimal passthrough
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, uses class-based test grouping, fixtures for HTTP test clients (FastAPI TestClient + httpx)
verification_instructions: Run python3 -m pytest tests/ -q and confirm all tests pass (currently 268). Then run python3 -c 'import agentwork' to confirm clean imports.
environment_constraints: Python 3.9.25 available via pyenv. No Docker daemon needed. No external API keys needed - all implementations use stubs/mocks for testing.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: pydantic models, never-fail guarantee on tool execution, type hints, comprehensive tests. All new modules must be exported from agentwork/__init__.py.
key_patterns: 1) Tools are pydantic BaseModel instances created via @tool decorator. 2) Tool.execute() never raises - returns TaskResult. 3) Server uses FastAPI with optional dependency pattern (try/except ImportError). 4) Tests use pytest classes, fixtures for FastAPI TestClient. 5) LRUResultStore pattern for bounded in-memory storage. 6) Company presets are factory functions returning List[Agent]. 7) Resilience patterns (RetryPolicy, CircuitBreaker, etc.) are composable. 8) All async methods have sync counterparts.
directory_structure: agentwork/ - main package: core/ (agent, result, context, exceptions), tools/ (base, decorators, registry), resilience/ (retry, fallback, circuit_breaker, timeout), engine/ (executor, pipeline, planner), fleet/ (manager, pool, router), server/ (app, fleet_app, middleware), infra/ (auth, cache, knowledge_base), presets/ (office, marketing, sales, digital, entertainment, company, companies/), scheduler/ (scheduler, worker, triggers), orchestrator.py, factory.py. tests/ - flat test files (test_core.py, test_tools.py, test_fleet.py, etc.)
